Sample.evidence_source: In order to be eligible to participate in this study, participants needed to be aged 18 years and over and fluent in the English language. Further, all participants had to have experienced a completed suicide of a family member at least 12 months prior to being interviewed and had to have had dealings with official agencies (e.g., police, coroner, insurance company, funeral directors, banks) related to the suicide of a family member.
